audience: Shopify merchants who track inventory batches, lot numbers and expiry dates with Freshly

useCases.title: Find batches that expire soon
useCases.text: List the inventory batches of a variant or location with their expiry dates. Open one batch by its id to read its quantity and details.

useCases.title: Trace the batches on an order line
useCases.text: List the batches assigned to one order line item, with the quantities and assignment ids. Open each batch to read its details.

useCases.title: Record a new batch from a delivery
useCases.text: Create a batch of one variant at one location, with its expiry date. Turn on Shopify sync only when the Shopify stock level must change too.

useCases.title: Assign batch quantity to an order line
useCases.text: Assign a quantity of one batch to an order line, so Freshly tracks which lot shipped. Remove a wrong assignment by its id.
